claim: The six model classes, organized by the engineering questions they answer.

topology.description: Six peer model classes; separate orthogonal representation-form axis.

required_terms: Behavioral What may happen? In what order?
Ownership Who controls? For how long?
Decision What is allowed? Which choice?
Representation form Graph · registry · state machine · contract · table · quantitative relation
Shared identity and traceability connect explicit engineering knowledge.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: Six peer boxes list structural, behavioral, ownership, decision, measurement and provenance models with the questions each answers. A separate representation-form axis lists graph, registry, state machine, contract, table and quantitative relation. Model purpose and representation form are distinct; shared identity and traceability connect the models. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
